title: Middle 50% Range Plotter
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Plot your GPA and ACT score against a college's middle 50% range and see whether you fall below, inside, or above it.

learningObjectives: Students will interpret a college's middle 50% range for GPA and test scores and classify their own numbers as above, inside, or below the range.

controls: Your GPA and Your ACT inputs
25th and 75th percentile inputs for GPA and ACT

keyQuestions: What fraction of admitted students scored below the 25th percentile?
Why might a test-optional college's reported ACT range be higher than its typical admitted student's score?
Does being inside the range guarantee admission? Why not?
commonMisconceptions: The middle 50% range is the minimum required to be admitted.
Scores below the 25th percentile mean automatic rejection.
assessmentOpportunities: Students correctly classify a given GPA and test score against a stated middle 50% range and explain what each zone means.
